summary: Parameterless wrapper that declares a local 8-dword (32-byte) stack buffer v1 and forwards it to StructInitWithSentinelValues, returning that call's result unchanged.

operations.description: Declare a local buffer v1 of 8 dwords (32 bytes) on the stack.
Call StructInitWithSentinelValues(v1), passing the local buffer to be initialized with sentinel values.

unresolved: Meaning of the 32-byte buffer layout and the sentinel values written by StructInitWithSentinelValues are unknown.
Why the buffer is local and discarded immediately after initialization is unknown.
Interpretation of the integer return value (success/failure/count) is not established.
